evidence_paraphrase: The 2019-2020 process concerned financing, drug licenses and potential collaborations. Following November 2020 trial results, counterparties were invited to submit program collaboration proposals in January. Whole-company acquisition interest and the first private bid arose in January 2021. The subsequent competitive private process ended in board approval March 3; execution and public announcement both occurred March 4, before Nasdaq trading. No earlier executed or publicly definitive company sale is described. Private collaboration discussions at January 1 are distinct from an announced control agreement.
